title: Drumroll, Please
novel:
There was a [[drumroll|drumroll]] from the little band, a moment of [[suspense|suspense]] — and then Ted saw her across the room.

The [[chemistry|chemistry]] was instant and [[mutual|mutual]]. They began to [[flirt|flirt]] badly and happily. She [[giggled|giggle]] at his worst joke. They [[whirled|whirl]] around the floor until both of them were [[breathless|breathless]] and slightly [[dizzy|dizzy]].

On a [[whim|whim]] they [[slipped away|slip away]] to the garden. He knew nothing about her: no job, no story, no name. She stayed [[anonymous|anonymous]] on purpose, and that only fed his [[curiosity|curiosity]].

"Ask me later," she said, and gave him a [[glimpse|glimpse]] of a smile that felt like a [[riddle|riddle]].

A [[cautious|cautious]] man would have asked at once. Ted let the moment [[linger|linger]] instead, full of [[delight|delight]], sure that time was on his side.

Then her friends called her; a car door closed; a quick [[farewell|farewell]] through the window.

She was gone before he could [[unmask|unmask]] her [[identity|identity]].

For weeks he searched. He learned an old lesson the hard way: magic is lovely, but a name is useful.

drumroll.cn: 鼓点（宣布大事前的连击）
drumroll.en: a fast rolling sound on a drum, played before big news

suspense.en: the excited feeling of waiting to find out what happens

chemistry.cn: （人与人之间的）来电、化学反应
chemistry.en: a strong natural liking between two people

mutual.en: felt or done by both people

flirt.en: to talk in a playful way to show you like someone

giggle.en: to laugh in a quiet, silly way

whirl.en: to turn round and round very fast

breathless.en: having trouble breathing after moving fast

dizzy.en: feeling that everything around you is turning

whim.en: a sudden idea to do something for no good reason

slip away.en: to leave quietly, without being noticed

anonymous.en: with a name that is not known

curiosity.en: the wish to know more about something

glimpse.en: a very quick look at something

riddle.en: a puzzle with a clever answer

cautious.en: careful, because something could go wrong

linger.en: to stay a little longer than you should

unmask.en: to show who someone really is
